_note: School props from art/props/nh_props.py. Dims are studs (W, D, H) as modelled; front faces -Z (LookVector) after import. Each prop uses one SurfaceAppearance with these maps. Door pieces swing on their hinge edge (swing -1 = hinge on the left, +1 = hinge on the right). Batch 3 pivot = the swing hinge (Blender X, Y, Z of a rocking piece: the clock's pendulum, the bell); *_Glow pieces become Neon, *_Glass pieces Glass. Batches 4-5: baked at 2048 from the 2048 source sets; *_Mirror pieces become reflective glass, *_Water pieces hidden water shown while open; rigged pieces (Door0, TapHot, TapCold) turn about their pivot (the FBX origin) through the locker system, the football machine's WheelL / WheelR spin about Z (Blender) on theirs. Batches 6-9: as 4-5; *_Pool pieces are water that always shows; *_Cloth pieces sway (NHSwing about their origin on the rod); Gramophone_Record spins (NHSpin); FilingCabinet_Drawer0 slides; ValveWheel_Wheel turns about its axle (Blender Y). Batches 10-14: as 6-9; *_Door0 pieces swing about their origin (the hinge), the TownDoor's into the building; CuriosityCabinet_Glass swings with its door; HeadmasterDesk_Drawer0 slides; *_Cloth pieces sway. Batches 10-14: as 6-9; *_Door0 pieces swing about their origin (the hinge), the TownDoor's into the building; CuriosityCabinet_Glass swings with its door; HeadmasterDesk_Drawer0 slides; *_Cloth pieces sway. Batches 15-17: the cafeteria and the spire; PendantLamp_Glass is crimson glass (set in props_setup15). Batch 18: the nine skateboards; each piece's origin is its pivot (trucks lean about the long axis, wheels spin about the axle). Batch 19: the lamp and light kit; maps published under the Nightmare Highschool group (Asset Manager bulk import), lights and tags set in props_setup19. Batch 20: the stair and bridge kit, group-owned maps, set up by props_setup20. Batch 21: the painting and art kit; each painting's *_Canvas piece carries its own 2048 painting (CanvasColorMap), set up by props_setup21.
